summary: NOVONIX Limited filed a Form 6-K with an ASX announcement detailing a change to its American Depositary Share (ADS) ratio from 1 ADS representing 4 ordinary shares to 1 ADS representing 40 ordinary shares, effective 27 August 2026. The change acts as a one-for-ten reverse ADS split and is intended to raise the per-ADS price to regain compliance with Nasdaq's minimum bid price requirement after receiving a deficiency notice on 18 March 2026. The move does not alter the number of ordinary shares on issue; the company continues to monitor compliance.
